name: Product-Linked Attributes Mapper for WooCommerce
author: Jordan Alexander

sections.description:
Make selected WooCommerce global attributes behave like products:
– When you search for attribute terms on the product edit screen, you can search PRODUCTS instead.
– Selected attribute values can link to the corresponding product page on the front-end.

Short Description

Turn selected WooCommerce global attributes into product-linked terms (search products in the admin and output clickable attribute values on product pages).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via Plugins.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to BigBad Agency > Product-Linked Attributes > Settings.
  4. Select the global attributes you want to map.
sections.changelog:

1.0.3

  • Fix: term→product lookup now uses get_terms() (no direct SQL) and adds object caching.
  • Fix: sanitize/unslash nonce handling on term save.
  • Meta: update readme compatibility headers.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
